candidate_evidence.quote: - [OTHER] Biological biomarker analysis: Collection of tumor and blood samples at T0 (surgery) and T1 (6 months follow-up)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have a radiological diagnosis of supratentorial glioblastoma, or
Have a radiological diagnosis of first recurrence of a primary supratentorial glioblastoma

biomarkers.biomarker_other: immune omic signatures (tumour lymphocyte subtypes, T-cell receptor subtypes)

source_quote.quote: Immune omic markers, namely the tumor count of the different lymphocyte subtypes and of T-cell receptor subtypes, will be correlated with overall survival.

coder_notes: Non-treatment biomarker/omics study (phase NA, single OTHER arm). Ex vivo stem-cell chemosensitivity testing names no drugs, so no agents listed. IDH-wildtype appears in the condition label only (used to define GBM), not coded as an eligibility biomarker.
